newsitem.title: MEXICO: SOCCER-MEXICO COACH RELENTS AND PICKS HERMOSILLO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MEXICO COACH RELENTS AND PICKS HERMOSILLO.

text.p: Mexico coach Bora Milutinovic has finally relented on his policy of leaving star striker Carlos Hermosillo out of the national team.
Hermosillo, consistently overlooked by both Milutinovic and his predecessor Miguel Mejia Baron, has been named in the squad for Saturday's World Cup qualifying match away to Honduras.

The exclusion of the Cruz Azul striker has caused a furore in Mexico where he has been the national championship's top-scorer for the last three seasons, outscoring imported stars such as Cameroon's Francois Omam-Biyik.
However, he was given a less-than-warm reception from some of his colleages.
One was quoted as saying: "There has been so much noise about not picking him, now he will have to show his qualities on the field."

Saturday's game is Mexico's second in semifinal group three of the CONCACAF qualifying competition. On Sunday, they won 3-0 away to St. Vincent's part-timers while their opponents lost by the same score away to Jamaica.
